2 marks: Provides a reason in favor of a distribution strategy OR provides characteristics and features of a distribution strategy

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Sales are higher than predicted. The business may therefore be finding it difficult to distribute the product quickly enough (physical distribution issue). They may have to increase the resources devoted to transport and warehousing to distribute their product to customers efficiently.
